scope.provenance_note: Namespace ownership does not by itself prove original authorship or semantic authority. The matrix classifies D10 donor relevance/ownership, not copyright authorship.

doctrine: Every owner-namespace repository is accounted for exactly once.
Repository presence, implementation language, or installation does not mint Core semantics.
Domain/application algorithms remain package-owned unless a separate substrate-independent Core law is proved.
Backend/compiler/OS/GPU details remain mechanisms; only explicit universal bridge/capability laws may be reviewed for Core.
Historical/reference repos may donate semantic provenance but never coordinates or implementation authority.
All candidate meanings still require exact D1-D9 duplicate, ownership, language-visible distinction and mechanism-only checks.
